translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: Manda la bilia battente in fondo al tavolo e indietro. Torna alla stecca?

translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: Manda a bola branca ao fundo da mesa e de volta. Volta ao taco?

translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: Mande a bola branca ao fundo da mesa e de volta. Ela volta ao taco?

translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: 手球を奥まで送って戻そう。キューのところへ戻ってくる?

translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: 수구를 테이블 끝까지 보냈다가 돌아오게 하세요. 큐로 돌아오나요?

translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: 把母球打到台尾再弹回来。它能回到球杆前吗？

translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: Пошлите биток вдоль стола и обратно. Вернётся ли он к кию?

translations.key: Send the cue ball up the table and back. Does it return to the cue?
translations.text: أرسل الكرة البيضاء إلى آخر الطاولة وعودتها. هل تعود إلى العصا؟
